entities.summary: John Albert Elway Jr. is an American former professional football player who spent his entire 16-year career as a quarterback with the Denver Broncos of the National Football League (NFL). Following his playing career, he then spent 11 years with the Broncos in various front office positions, eventually being promoted to general manager. Elway and former backup quarterback and head coach Gary Kubiak are the only individuals to be associated with all three of the Broncos' Super Bowl wins. John Elway was a athletes & competitors from Port Angeles (b. 1960-06-28, Port Angeles). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: John Elway's two Super Bowl wins with the Denver Broncos in 1997 and 1998 had a significant impact on the NFL, cementing his legacy as one of the greatest quarterbacks in league history. His involvement in the team's front office also contributed to their success during the late 1990s and early 2000s.
